KaTeX 0.16.25 is vendored for the VM-handler article's LaTeX mathematics.
Source: https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX/releases/tag/v0.16.25
Files: dist/katex.min.css, dist/katex.min.js,
dist/contrib/auto-render.min.js, and dist/fonts/ from the npm package.
The upstream MIT notice is preserved in LICENSE.
